title: 用 n 个等圆覆盖正五边形
titleEn: Covering a regular pentagon with n equal discs

knownBest.source: The public vector construction in Figure 9 of Yanchao Liu (2022), reconstructed point by point and verified here at 0.213065485409387. Table 1 gives only the three-decimal value 22.402 in its width-100 coordinate system; the leaderboard uses the verifier-exact grid score of the reproducible Figure 9 construction rather than pretending the low-precision table entry is an exact certificate. The paper's best lower bound still leaves a 5.87% gap, so optimality is open.
